# Assertions claims

Statements and classifications validate Assertions package 2.0.0 at [b6c7bc282fd6cea97c62017f468c7ecfd6dc37aa](https://github.com/blossomlabs/assertions/tree/b6c7bc282fd6cea97c62017f468c7ecfd6dc37aa). Individual contract versions and source hashes are recorded in [project.json](project.json). Each claim links to its precise scope and evidence references in [claims.json](claims.json). Full labels retain their stated ABI, resource and execution premises.

The retained Halmos baseline passed 382 properties. Source, native, runtime and implication evidence remain separate; see [the receipt index](evidence-index.json) and [reproduction instructions](README.md).

Generated theorem links open their declarations and accepted hashes in claims.json. Full expanded sources are published in the [CI artifacts](https://github.com/BlossomLabs/Assertions-FormalVerification/actions/workflows/verification.yml).
